method: Seven original source-checked summaries with exact title, author, ISBN and language bindings. Five public bibliographic records corrected under guarded updates. No copied synopsis, invented plot ending or present-day legal validity claim.

entries.title: Koppensnellers, uitrangeerders en selecteurs
entries.author: Stefan Lievens
entries.text: Pol Coetsier en Stefan Lievens behandelen arbeidsbemiddeling als een beroep in verandering. Hun boek plaatst het zoeken, selecteren en begeleiden van personeel in het perspectief van de jaren negentig en de aanloop naar het jaar 2000. Het richt de aandacht op de beroepspraktijk achter personeelsbeleid. Deze publicatie uit 1992 biedt daarmee een historische invalshoek op de ontwikkeling van arbeidsbemiddeling.
entries.identityNotes: Exact ISBN in UGent institutional record. Both authors named in synopsis; existing primary-author relation retained. Incorrect English parenthetical removed from the Dutch title. Description limited to documented scope.

entries.title: Law and Legal Information Directory
entries.author: Laurie J. Fundukian
entries.text: The nineteenth edition of this reference directory brings together information about legal organizations, services and programmes. It is designed as a starting point for locating institutions and sources within the legal information field. Edited by Laurie J. Fundukian and published by Gale in 2008, it belongs to a series of institutional directories rather than a textbook explaining legal rules. The edition date matters when using its contact details, which describe the organizations as recorded at that time.
entries.identityNotes: Exact 19th-edition ISBN and 2008 date verified in edition catalogue; institutional library describes the series scope. No modern contact validity, current law or later-edition entry counts implied.

entries.title: Fatal Deception
entries.author: Sally Wentworth
entries.text: Norrie has rebuilt her life after a disastrous relationship with Bruno Denton, the man who took over her father’s newspaper. Four years earlier, her trust in him helped put her father’s future at risk. Now Bruno returns with ambitions that extend beyond business: he also wants a place in her young nephew’s life. Sally Wentworth’s romance brings Norrie’s unresolved feelings into conflict with her determination to protect her family, as past betrayal shapes a new confrontation.
entries.identityNotes: Exact 1992 large-print edition retained. Shared plot confirmed in work catalogue and original Harlequin edition; no invented ending or assumptions about the nephew’s parentage.

entries.title: Diego Rivera: Illustrious Words, 1886–1921
entries.author: Diego Rivera
entries.text: This illustrated exhibition catalogue presents Diego Rivera through his words and reflections on art. The first volume, covering 1886–1921, follows his childhood, artistic training and encounters with the European avant-garde. Writings and images bring his development as an artist into conversation with his observations about other artists and their work. Produced in connection with the Museo Estudio Diego Rivera, the volume offers a perspective on the muralist as a storyteller and critic as well as a painter.
entries.identityNotes: Exact Mexican ISBN and English language in CiNii; exact OL edition subtitle identifies first volume, 1886–1921. Catalogue published 2007; work-level 1929 date was for a different Rivera publication. Official RM catalogue and distributor confirm first-volume scope.

entries.title: The Broken Link
entries.author: Yvonne Whittal
entries.text: Janey still loves Rudolph, but the memory of his broken promise has made trust difficult. When he asks her to marry him for their child’s sake, she must confront feelings that have survived their separation. She believes he promised himself to her while already committed to another woman, and fears that this attachment remains. Yvonne Whittal’s romance centres on the tension between a possible reunion, responsibility for a child and Janey’s need to understand the man she loves.
entries.identityNotes: Existing ISBN-10 0263726509 belongs to this Mills & Boon work; verified equivalent ISBN-13 is 9780263726503. Wrong ISBN-13 9780373708185 belongs to Laura Abbot’s The Wedding Vow. Google Books publisher record confirms Mills & Boon and 1978. OL prose used only for plot; erroneous OL ISBN-13 and publisher/date rejected.

entries.title: Viglius van Aytta als hoogleraar te Ingolstadt
entries.author: J. G. B. Pikkemaat
entries.sourceName: Staatsbibliothek zu Berlin / GBV — titelblad en inhoudsopgave
entries.text: J.G.B. Pikkemaat onderzoekt de rechtscolleges die Viglius van Aytta tussen 1537 en 1542 in Ingolstadt gaf. Centraal staat hoe rechtspraktijk, traditionele rechtsgeleerdheid en humanisme in dat onderwijs samenkomen. Aan de hand van concrete Romeinsrechtelijke vraagstukken bespreekt hij onder meer eigendomsoverdracht, schenking en de verhouding tussen rechter en wet. Het onderzoek verbindt de uitleg van juridische teksten met het intellectuele klimaat van de zestiende eeuw. Zo wordt zichtbaar welke vragen en methoden het toenmalige universitaire rechtsonderwijs vormgaven.
entries.identityNotes: Exact thesis ISBN verified; scanned original title page and contents show modern spelling hoogleraar, 1537–1542, and the named chapter subjects. No present-day legal advice.

entries.title: Fertility, Food and Fever
entries.author: David Henley
entries.text: David Henley examines how population, economic activity and the environment changed in North and Central Sulawesi between 1600 and 1930. Drawing on Dutch historical records, including trading-company and missionary archives, he reconstructs patterns of settlement, livelihoods and landscape change. Disease, food supply and reproductive fertility become connected explanations for the region’s demographic history. The study combines historical geography with demography to question simple assumptions about population growth and its relationship to agricultural resources and environmental change.
entries.identityNotes: Correct KITLV print ISBN 9789067182096 / 9067182095 and 2005 year confirmed by Google Books scanned catalogue and UIII university library. Previous ISBN 9789067181655 belongs to an Indonesian-Dutch law dictionary; the incorrect imported 2004 record is not accepted as bibliographic authority.
